title: 食安风波冲击餐饮股 业绩预警引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: In the food space, Papa John's down 17 percent on the day.
segments.zh: 食品板块中，棒约翰今日下跌17%。

segments.en: Some concerns here about their growth story going forward and well, there's some bigger concerns going on in the restaurant space as well.
segments.zh: 市场对其未来增长有所担忧，同时餐饮行业也存在更广泛的忧虑。

segments.en: And that is our top story, a focus on restaurant stocks amid a food safety scare that is making things maybe a little bit more complicated for an industry that was already
segments.zh: 这是我们的头条，聚焦餐饮股，食品安全恐慌让本已复杂的行业雪上加霜。

segments.en: dealing with the myriad of other complex issues. The largest outbreak ever recorded in the U.S.
segments.zh: 该行业已面临诸多复杂问题，而这次是美国有史以来最大规模的疫情。

segments.en: Recyclospora. It's a parasite that causes severe diarrhea.
segments.zh: 环孢子虫，一种导致严重腹泻的寄生虫。

segments.en: That outbreak was quietly identified months ago, but it was only in early June that the mass public really became aware of it.
segments.zh: 疫情在数月前已被发现，但直到六月初公众才广泛知晓。

segments.en: Since then, an index of restaurant stocks that includes McDonald's, and Chipotle, Brinker, Wendy's, Aura Mark, and others, it's been under pressure.
segments.zh: 自那以来，包含麦当劳、Chipotle等在内的餐饮股指数承压。

segments.en: Takes years at Kava. They're down 9 percent since that time. Young brands have slid about 10 percent.
And then there was this closely held upstart chain called Saladin Go, which just filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy saying the outbreak worsened its existing business challenges.
segments.zh: 还有一家名为Saladin Go的新兴连锁申请破产，称疫情加剧了其经营困境。

segments.en: And that's not all. There's a salmonella outbreak out there. A small one involving high-alapenial peppers that has begun to unfold.
segments.zh: 此外，还有一起涉及辣椒的沙门氏菌疫情正在发酵。

segments.en: And there's a lot of confusion about the CDC's messaging on this or rather the lack thereof.
segments.zh: 关于CDC的公告，或者说缺乏公告，存在很多困惑。

segments.en: And that has a lot of customers just deciding we're not going to take any chances.
segments.zh: 这导致很多顾客决定不冒险。

segments.en: We're just going to stay away from raw veggies and quite frankly, the restaurants that sell them.
segments.zh: 他们决定远离生蔬菜，以及销售这些蔬菜的餐厅。

segments.en: We just heard from one of those restaurants, sweet green, salad chain, raw vegetables, same-store sales growth.
segments.zh: 我们刚刚听到其中一家餐厅的消息，Sweetgreen，沙拉连锁店，销售生蔬菜，同店销售额增长。

segments.en: It was down. It was expected to be down. And it was down more than expected.
segments.zh: 它下降了。原本预期会下降，但实际下降幅度超过预期。

segments.en: They gave a forecast for the full year and said same-store sales.
segments.zh: 他们给出了全年预测，并表示同店销售额。

segments.en: They will be down about 8 percent.
